name: Family Conflict
overview: Scripture acknowledges that family conflict is a reality, as Jesus Himself foretold divisions even among close relatives (Matthew 10:35). However, believers are called to reject retaliation and instead pursue peace and integrity in all relationships (Romans 12:17; Matthew 5:38). Trusting in God’s guidance (Proverbs 3:6) and relying on the Holy Spirit’s teaching and comfort (John 14:26) equip Christians to navigate the tensions between love and strife (Ecclesiastes 3:8) with grace and wisdom.
